hotels.title: Tranquil Fiji Coral Coast Villa Hideaway with Private Beach
hotels.description: Serenity is on the menu at the oceanfront Tambua Sands Beach Resort, a pocket of paradise along the Coral Coast. Between moments spent sprawled on the private beach or splashing in the ocean, you can take advantage of the resort's exceptional facilities. Lunch and dinner are a casual affair at Tambua Sands Restaurant, where fresh seafood, traditional Fijian dishes and an extensive drinks list are perfectly accompanied by the ocean backdrop. Cool off in the vast freshwater pool, sip tropical cocktails on a sun lounger or try your hand at beach volleyball. When it's time to shake things up, nearby you can discover walking trails, sand dunes, adventure parks and a nine-hole golf course. If it's ocean magic you're after, there's snorkelling, canoeing and kayaking available. Access to the fitness centre and spa services at neighbouring resorts can be arranged, so you can enjoy the perfect balance of barefoot bliss and luxury amenities.

hotels.title: Adults-Only Fiji Coral Coast Hideaway with All-Inclusive Dining, Nightly Drinks & Guided Reef Walks
hotels.description: Serenity is on the menu at this Coral Coast hideaway, a pocket of paradise fringed by golden shores and swaying palms. During your stay, savour moments spent sprawled on the private beach, splashing in the ocean or climbing the mountains on guided hikes. With every meal included, dining is an effortless and casual affair at Tambua Sands Restaurant, where fresh seafood, traditional Fijian dishes and nightly drinks perfectly accompany the ocean backdrop. Cool off in the vast freshwater pool, sip tropical cocktails on a sun lounger or try your hand at beach volleyball. When it’s time to shake things up, you can discover walking trails, sand dunes, adventure parks and a nine-hole golf course nearby. If it’s ocean magic that you’re after, then snorkelling, canoeing and kayaking are available at your whim.

hotels.title: Fiji Coral Coast Bliss with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Dinner, Sunset Cruise & Two Kids Stay Free
hotels.description: Soak up the sun, escape the crowds and set your watch to island time on Fiji’s Coral Coast at this family-friendly beachfront retreat. Spread across 38 acres of dreamy palms and a private stretch of sugar-fine sand, this hideaway's unbeatable location will whisk you away from the rest of the world. Here, every family member will find their slice of tropical paradise. Splash in the lagoon-style pool, lounge at the swim-up bar or let any stresses melt away with a treatment at Joy Spa. Soak up the sun with a round of golf on the nine-hole course or cool off in the azure Fijian waters. Every day, indulge in a delicious breakfast and dinner at the laid-back beachfront Nukunuku Restaurant. When you’re in the mood for something new, indulge in the romance of Talei Restaurant’s adults-only fine dining experience or savour Chinese flavours at Bamboo Terrace.

hotels.title: Fiji Coral Coast Family-Friendly Escape with Private Beach & Kids Club
hotels.description: Soak up the sun, escape the crowds and set your watch to island time on Fiji's Coral Coast at The Naviti Resort - a beachfront paradise perfect for rest and relaxation. Nestled amid tropical gardens, with a private stretch of sugar-fine sand, The Naviti Resort’s unbeatable location will instantly make you forget the outside world. Spread across 38 acres of tropical palms and just under two hours from Nadi, this is a secluded sanctuary for the entire family. Facilities include an exceptional swimming pool, swim-up bar, four distinct food and drink outlets, the indulgent Joy Spa and a stunning nine-hole golf course. Find a sun-kissed patch of sand to relax on, cool off in the azure Fijian waters or explore the pristine Coral Coast shores by boat. Venture out of the fabulous resort to discover the secrets of the nearby Biausevu Waterfall and Sigatoka Sand Dunes National Park, or take the whole family on an educational daytrip to the Kula WILD Adventure Park.

hotels.title: Fiji Coral Coast Oasis with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Dinner, Massages & Kids Stay Free
hotels.description: Surround yourself with the unspoiled beauty of Fiji’s Coral Coast, where glittering turquoise waters, towering palm trees and long stretches of golden sand provide the perfect setting for an unforgettable escape. Within moments of arrival, check into your newly-refurbished room and prepare to be met with warm Fijian hospitality as you slip into the rhythm of island time. Here, all you need to think about is which corner of the pool to laze by, where your next day trip will be, or which of the many mouthwatering restaurants you should visit tonight. Will you indulge in freshly caught seafood at Wicked Walu, Japanese fine dining at Sazanami, Italian delights at Pappagallo or international favourites at Bula Brasserie? Couples or honeymooners will love this romantic tropical haven, with days spent in the dedicated adults-only corner of the hotel or indulging in a lavish treatment at the Warwick Spa overlooking a serene lagoon. Meanwhile, families are well catered for with an array of activities for all ages, including a complimentary kids' club and pool.
